recovery.name: F42
recovery.protocol: 20s, no resets, deterministic policy, nominal dynamics; hroot>.65 and gz<-.9 for 1s; zero command for recovery; 128 standing trials commands 0/.5/1/2m/s every 5s

commands.name: F42
commands.protocol: 8 matched initial joint perturbations per command, 2s standing then 10s command; no resets/push/DR/smoothing; torso yaw-frame xy velocity and world torso yaw rate; final5s means

limitations: Nominal dynamics, deterministic inference, no disturbances or resets.
Recovery time includes 1 second stable standing; means are conditional on success.
F/G have two seeds, H one; no statistical superiority claim.
F is shared conditional network with mode-specific normalization, not legacy unconditional AMP.
This protocol does not measure motion naturalness or command resumption after recovery.
